AskYourDatabase.PluginDescription: Chat with your data in Matomo using your AskYourDatabase AI chatbot.
AskYourDatabase.ApiKeyDescription: API key created in the API Key page of your AskYourDatabase dashboard. The secret key used by the previous versions of the plugin no longer works.
AskYourDatabase.ChatbotIdDescription: ID of the chatbot to display, found in its URL in your AskYourDatabase dashboard (for example https://www.askyourdatabase.com/dashboard/chatbot/5da7b8cf3a372f5e6e6b64af9ae189c7). You can paste the full URL.
AskYourDatabase.ChatbotIdInvalid: The chatbot ID is not valid. Paste the ID or the URL of the chatbot from your AskYourDatabase dashboard.
AskYourDatabase.UserNameDescription: Name used for the chat sessions in AskYourDatabase. Leave empty to use the login of the Matomo user.
AskYourDatabase.UserEmailDescription: Email used for the chat sessions in AskYourDatabase. Leave empty to use the email of the Matomo user.
AskYourDatabase.NotConfiguredDescription: Enter the API key and the chatbot ID of your AskYourDatabase account in the plugin settings to start chatting with your data.
AskYourDatabase.NotConfiguredNoAccount: No account yet? Create one on %1$sAskYourDatabase%2$s.
AskYourDatabase.SessionError: The AskYourDatabase session could not be created: %s
AskYourDatabase.CredentialsRefused: the API key or the chatbot ID was refused (%s). Check them in the plugin settings.
